prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Create an exceptionally beautiful image for a contemporary premium pet photography and memories website. Art direction: playful fashion editorial, exquisite detail, clean sculptural composition, luminous soft daylight, rich but restrained pastel colours, tactile materials, delightful personality. Prioritise aesthetic impact over literal app-output realism. The pet must look alive, sweet and naturally expressive, with believable anatomy and finely resolved fur. No human body, no human hands, no extra limbs, no stock-photo props clutter, no sepia filter, no brown vintage room, no app interface, no watermark, no logos. No lettering unless explicitly specified. Full bleed, no outer border. A beautiful Chinese brown tabby cat rendered as a joyful hand-cut paper sculpture, distinctive forehead stripes and round green eyes, surrounded by geometric cobalt-blue leaves, coral flowers and cream paper shapes. Modern gallery illustration with visible paper fibres, sophisticated playful design, no text. Intended final composition 900:1200; keep face, ears and important artwork comfortably within the central safe area for a small crop.
